# Nav Digital Skills

> Nav Digital Skills is a premier full-service digital marketing agency based in Sector 51B, Chandigarh, India. Founded and led by Navjot Dhaliwal, the agency specializes in performance-driven digital marketing, high-ROAS Google Ads management, social media marketing (SMM), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO) for AI search engines, creative graphic design, and brand growth strategies.

- **Core Focus**: High Return-on-Ad-Spend (ROAS) campaigns, AI engine visibility, multi-platform social advertising, conversion rate optimization, and brand identity design.

## Core Agency Services

- [Google Ads Agency Services](https://navdigitalskills.com/google-ads-agency.html): Certified Google Ads campaign management across Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max (PMax), and YouTube Ads designed for maximum conversions and minimum cost-per-acquisition.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & AI Search Agency](https://navdigitalskills.com/aeo-agency.html): Modern optimization strategies for AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot) using structured data, schema markup, semantic entity mapping, and conversational search authority.
- [Social Media Marketing (SMM) Agency](https://navdigitalskills.com/social-media-marketing-agency.html): End-to-end paid and organic social media marketing across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn, YouTube, and X (Twitter) focused on audience targeting, lead generation, and community growth.
- [Creative Graphic Design Agency](https://navdigitalskills.com/graphics-designing-agency.html): High-impact visual brand assets, social media creatives, ad banners, corporate pitch decks, logo systems, and marketing collateral engineered for high click-through rates.
- [All Agency Services](https://navdigitalskills.com/services.html): Complete catalog of digital marketing, search optimization, PPC management, and creative services offered to businesses in Chandigarh, the Tri-city area, and global clients.
